jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an impactful position, working closely with planners around the world, conducting thorough research to elicit requirements and translate them into effective solutions.




ABOUT YOU

You’re a “product person” who knows how to build software products.

You speak the language of engineers and designers, yet you don’t rely too heavily on them to devise and evaluate solutions.

Intellectual honesty, personal integrity, curiosity, and EQ shape how you work with end users and elicit non-obvious requirements.

Async or IRL, you style-flex to meet your audience where they’re at, distill complexity to simplicity, and have an “owner’s mentality.”




WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will lead product initiatives that make military staffs superhuman and bring people home safely. You will work alongside the operators who imagined and built Onebrief - the product they needed.

Our team is highly specialized, and the core skillset for this role is a deep-thinker who understands complex systems and workflows.

You will work across our squads, rotating fluidly across domains, using a product perspective to create a seamless user experience.




WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - You have a comprehensive understanding of the current state of web technologies and best practices, and are forever experimenting with what’s “next”

 - You are naturally inclined to apply a design thinking approach to problem solving, and iteratively seek to understand your users, challenge assumptions, redefine problems and create innovative solutions which you can prototype and test

 - Attention to detail and pragmatism

 - Crisp, clear, concise communications, both written and orally.

 - You have an “owner’s mentality” and are comfortable sharing your ideas and perspective with the C-suite, and you take accountability when they reflect in the real-world

 - Experience developing B2B/SaaS products using modern collaboration tools

 - Most importantly:
   
   - You are collaborative, work iteratively, and are scrappy and solutions-oriented
   
   - You have an understanding of or interest in the military and defense tech space
   
   - You thrive as a self-starter, embracing autonomy and ambiguity
   
   - You are a U.S. citizen


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Atom Engine
jobs.description:
CONSEQUENTIAL WORK. DEDICATED PEOPLE.



ABOUT ONEBRIEF


Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Content team creates the scenarios, units, and entities that make up Atom Engine exercises. You will own the vision for what that content should deliver and how it gets built.

This is a senior individual contributor role that brings product leadership to Content. You will translate user needs and company priorities into a clear strategy, roadmap, and requirements, giving our content specialists the direction they need to execute effectively. Your accountability spans both the quality and usefulness of our content and the process through which we create, maintain, and improve it.




ABOUT YOU

You’re a product thinker who can bring structure and direction to a complex domain. You understand how to move from user needs to a clear vision, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and turn that vision into actionable priorities.

You combine systems thinking with attention to detail. You can understand how scenarios, units, and entities work together to support an exercise, while also seeing how individual content decisions affect the broader experience.

Intellectual honesty, curiosity, and empathy shape how you work. You seek out the expertise of users and content specialists, uncover requirements that aren’t immediately obvious, and make decisions that help the team move forward. You’re comfortable setting direction amid ambiguity and taking accountability for outcomes.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the Content vision and roadmap. Define how AE content should evolve to meet user needs and support Onebrief’s broader product direction.

 - Turn needs into clear priorities. Work with users and internal stakeholders to identify content gaps, define requirements, and decide what the team should build next—and why.

 - Own the Content process. Partner with the team to improve how content is requested, scoped, created, validated, maintained, and reused. Identify bottlenecks and prioritize improvements to workflows and supporting tools.

 - Define successful outputs. Establish clear expectations for the accuracy, consistency, usability, and fitness for purpose of scenarios, units, and entities.

 - Enable focused execution. Resolve ambiguity, manage competing requests, and make timely scope and priority decisions so content specialists can concentrate on delivery.

 - Connect Content with the broader product. Work across product, engineering, design, and domain experts to align content needs with product capabilities and dependencies.

 - Measure and improve outcomes. Use exercise feedback, user research, and production data to assess content effectiveness and guide improvements to both the content and the process.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - Experience owning strategy and execution for a complex product, content portfolio, or production workflow.

 - Strong product judgment, including the ability to prioritize competing needs and translate broad goals into actionable requirements.

 - A deep understanding of simulation technologies and workflows, with an appreciation for how content quality shapes the user experience.

 - A systems-oriented approach to improving processes, balancing quality, speed, maintainability, and scale.

 - Clear, concise communication and the ability to build alignment across technical teams, domain experts, and senior leadership.

 - A collaborative, pragmatic approach, with respect for specialist expertise and the confidence to make decisions.

 - Comfort working autonomously, navigating ambiguity, and taking accountability for results.

 - An understanding of, or strong interest in, the military and defense technology space.

 - U.S. citizenship.


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
